newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ASX substantial shareholding notices - Feb 3.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ASX substantial shareholding notices - Feb 3.

text.p: The following substantial shareholder notices have been made to The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).

The Capital Group Companies Inc became a substantial shareholder in Novus Petroleum Limited on 28/01/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 5,365,355 ordinary shares (5.03%).

Carlton & United Breweries Ltd increased its relevant interest in Ballarat Brewing Company Limited (The) on 30/01/1997, from 19,114,892 ordinary shares (70.54%) to 19,435,897 ordinary shares (71.73%).
Permanent Trustee Company Ltd decreased its relevant interest in Australian Topmaking Services Limited on 15/01/1997, from 13,840,000 ordinary shares (12.38%) to 10,840,000 ordinary shares (9.7%).
Maple-Brown Abbott Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Forrestania Gold NL on 28/01/1997.
Permanent Trustee Co Ltd increased its relevant interest in Sgio Insurance Limited on 31/01/1997, from 18,235,729 ordinary shares (9.30%) to 20,473,626 ordinary shares (10.44%).
Permanent Trustee Company Ltd increased its relevant interest in Transurban Group on 31/01/1997, from 105,097 ordinary shares (11.55%) to 116,934 ordinary shares (12.85%).
MMI General Insurance Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Arthur Yates & Company Limited on 30/01/1997.
Permanent Trustee Company Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Mount Edon Gold Mines (Aust) Limited on 22/01/1997.
General Oriental Investments Limited and Associates ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Elders Australia Limited on 30/01/1997.
Climax Mining Ltd increased its relevant interest in Equatorial Mining NL on 22/01/1997, from 25,828,838 ordinary shares (8.16%) to 39,380,000 ordinary shares (12.44%).
Ashton Mining Ltd increased/decreased its relevant interest in Australian Diamond Exploration NL on 30/01/1997, from 37,018,076 ordinary shares (83.47%) to 37,018,076 ordinary shares (83.47%).
Broomehill Pty Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Kresta Holdings Limited on 29/01/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 7,210,000 ordinary shares (6.46%).

Permanent Trustee Company Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Portman Mining Limited on 22/01/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 5,856,459 ordinary shares (5.39%).
Christian Nominees Pty Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Transcom International Limited on 28/01/1997.
Equitilink Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Waraluck Limited on 19/08/1996.
Permanent Trustee Company Ltd increased its relevant interest in Nautronix Limited on 31/01/1997, from 1,528,240 ordinary shares (6.31%) to 5,208,825 ordinary shares (10.79%).
Joshua Norman Pitt became a substantial shareholder in Hampton Hill Mining NL on 29/01/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 22,296,108 ordinary shares (52.06%).
